about: Architecture files whose bytes differ but whose output is bit-identical, measured on a real model. check_cache / pairing_problems accept a stamp pair whose ONLY difference is an arch hash pair listed here for that model_type (field: arch_sha256 by default, or arch_tree_sha256, the hash over the arch file and the arch modules it imports, compared when both stamps carry it); any other difference still refuses. An entry needs a bit-exact comparison on a real artifact, never a tiny model alone. (runtime/equivalent_revisions.json is the same idea for the VQ runtime.)

entries.new_source: knurlogic v0.1.6 (1e7a0cab) same path: vendored edit 9, GatedDeltaNet conv/silu/split/q-k norm and gated output norm under mx.compile (KNURLOGIC_GDN_COMPILE, on by default)
entries.evidence: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B VQ-3.8bpw (pinned copy), three fresh processes: the old file registered as mlx_lm.models.qwen3_5, the new file with KNURLOGIC_GDN_COMPILE=on, and =off. Prose, code and literary house corpora, first 512 tokens each, full-vocab bf16 logits at every prefill position plus 16 greedy decode steps: 393,338,880 logits per arm compared as uint16 bit patterns, 0 differ in any pair; greedy tokens identical.

entries.old_source: knurlogic 0bd344d6 (unreleased, first gdn-compile commit) same path
entries.evidence: The files differ by one comment line (the measured decode speedup); no code differs. The new file is bit-identical to the pre-compile file on the 35B (entry above).

entries.evidence: Derived from the qwen3_5 entry above, not a new measurement. The two trees differ in exactly one file, the base qwen3_5.py (01392a3f -> b21d9903); the MoE subclass file and every other module in the tree are byte-identical (knurlogic v0.1.5..v0.1.6 changed only qwen3_5.py and qwen4_exp.py under engine/families). That base-file pair was proven bit-identical on the real Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE model (model_type qwen3_5_moe) with exactly this tree: the old file was registered as mlx_lm.models.qwen3_5 beside the unchanged subclass and the same mlx-lm 0.32.0 modules. 393,338,880 logits per arm, 0 differ; greedy tokens identical.
